title: Establish the deterministic Warframe progression tutor under KAD authority
authority_required: operator instruction, 2026-09-12: create the project, use warframe-helper and any available tooling, run it under kad-pi and the OMP harness, publish a private repo
scope: a deterministic progression engine over the player's account snapshot and the WFCD item data: quest order, mastery arithmetic, recipe shortfalls, star-chart completion, early-game mod gaps, economy constraints
a CLI (status, next, mr, quests, item, build, price, refresh, check) with JSON output and explicit exit codes, usable from any directory in the workspace
curated data files carrying their own provenance (quest order, early-game essentials)
a hermetic test suite over synthetic fixtures
workspace enrollment: the project registry entry and a portable skill so any harness session can invoke the tutor
non_scope: modelling Arbitrations, Steel Path, liches, Rivens, Incarnon adapters or Archon hunts, which need progression flags the API does not expose
navigating the star chart: unlocked-but-incomplete nodes cannot be distinguished from locked ones in the snapshot
relic reward analysis (Relics.json is available but not loaded in this version)
any inference on the advice path: the tutor reports UNKNOWN rather than estimating a missing fact
mutating the player's account data or the warframe-helper window, which stays the acquisition surface
acceptance_criteria: `python -m unittest discover -s tests` runs the full suite and exits 0, with the mastery curves asserted against the game's published values
`bin/kad-warframe next` ranks real actions for this account from the live snapshot, and every action carries non-empty evidence
with a declared platinum balance of zero, no action recommends spending platinum (test-enforced)
a stale or missing input produces exit 1 and an explicit warning, and is never silently advised upon
the project is enrolled in .agents/workspace/projects.json with its validation command, and a portable skill documents how a harness session invokes it
evidence records the verification run and the exact commands behind it
priority_note: a new player at MR 4 with 0 platinum needs farmable advice, so the tutor's first version favours mastery, quests and resource shortfalls over late-game systems
